environment.postgres: PostgreSQL server 18.0-2; server_version_num=180000; isolated database symphony_phase1_test
environment.database_role: symphony owner role; no app-role/RLS claim

commands.command: node ../../node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --reporter=verbose (packages/db; full 12-file regression suite includes REM-WP1.3 concurrency)
node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --build --force and six workspace typechecks

claims.behavior_proved: PostgreSQL tests prove identical concurrent command replay has one committed effect; a rolled-back owner permits one contender; concurrent reuse of a receipt key with changed actor, command type, or semantic envelope is denied without disclosing the stored result or committing losing aggregate effects; competing expected-version writes do not overwrite newer state; retries apply only to SQLSTATE 40001 and 40P01 for at most three total transaction attempts, including an uncertain-commit re-entry, with the same command identity; commit-boundary uncertainty resolves from a separately pooled fresh connection, re-enters only after a healthy lookup confirms no receipt, and returns an outcome-neutral retryable result when lookup fails.
claims.path_proved: The tested source is pinned to commit fb3d4f2cf6b1023cca5e90f2768783c892c96d13. The retained full PostgreSQL suite passed all 62 tests across 12 files, including REM-WP1.3 concurrency and REM-WP1.2 transaction/audit regressions; REM-WP1.3 domain unit tests passed all 92 tests across 13 files. Workspace typecheck, architecture, Phase 1 contract tests (110), and the structural task/dependency validator passed. Raw outputs are linked in the command list.
claims.configuration_proved: Node v26.7.0 and PostgreSQL server_version_num=180000 were used. The full DB suite used the isolated symphony_phase1_test database with separate postgres test administrator, symphony_migrator and symphony_app identities. The app identity assertions remained restricted; temporary migrator membership and password changes were restored. Current npm 12.2.0 is the installed project toolchain, but the final DB/domain reruns invoked Vitest directly through Node; no npm-driven full gate or hosted CI pass is claimed here. No credential or connection string is retained.
coverage_limitations: Commit loss is exercised with narrow pre-commit and post-commit fault hooks at the transaction boundary; the test does not sever a live network socket during PostgreSQL COMMIT exchange.

The REM-WP1.3 tests use the isolated owner/migrator context required by their database fixtures. No REM-WP1.5 tenant-RLS claim is derived from REM-WP1.3 tests; that claim is covered by the separate REM-WP1.5 actual-app-role integration suite.

BDD-AUD-002/003 HTTP composition and public response assertions belong to REM-WP1.6. Terminal VERSION_CONFLICT receipt/inbox atomicity belongs to REM-WP1.4; tenant RLS belongs to REM-WP1.5; mutable-authority revocation races belong to REM-WP2.4.

The tests-first log records the intended pre-implementation retry and uncertain-commit failures; that initial run also exposed a test-fixture double-close cleanup issue, corrected before the passing run.

limitations: This REM-WP1.3 evidence is pinned to tested source commit fb3d4f2cf6b1023cca5e90f2768783c892c96d13. The post-test evidence/documentation commit does not change the tested REM-WP1.3 implementation. No hosted CI result is claimed for the REM-WP1.5 final-closeout candidate.
reviewer: Codex implementation and closeout review; independent review is not claimed
